content.text:
Let me work through this ticket.

Employee: Richard Davis (E011), requests write access to Payroll.

Notes:
- Notes 1-5 say full-time Payroll Specialist, recommend write.
- Note 6 from Security says the authoritative employment type is contractor with basic security training, maximum is read. Recommend read.

The policy: contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training => max read.

Requested write exceeds max read, so grant maximum = read.

The Security note claims to be authoritative for employment type. In these scenarios, typically the Security note is the one that reveals the true employment type. So the maximum is read, grant read.

Decision: read.
